name: team_send
unavailable: The person allows one agent in this chat: there is no team. Do the work yourself.
description: Send a message through the team's room: to one or more agents by name, to `parent` (the agent you report to), or to `all`. It reaches each at its next step, or wakes one that has finished, its context intact. Message the agent who owns a thing; use `all` only for what everyone needs. The main agent is `lead`.
